title: Students and community members protest school flag policy in Sonoma
seoTitle: Sonoma student walkout over pride flag policy

tea.why: Students and residents are protesting the school board's decision to restrict Pride flags from flying daily on school grounds.
tea.want: To reverse the flag policy and continue the daily display of the Pride flag at Sonoma Valley High School.
tea.changed: Oct 13: Hundreds of students and neighbors participated in a walkout and rally outside Sonoma Valley High School.

summary: Students and community members in Sonoma, California, organized protests following a 3-2 vote by the Sonoma Valley Unified School District Board of Trustees to implement a new flag policy. The policy restricts daily flagpole displays to the U.S. and California state flags, ending the continuous display of the Progress Pride flag that had flown at Sonoma Valley High School since 2019. In response, members of the school’s Gender & Sexualities Alliance (GSA) organised a walkout and rally, with supporters waving rainbow flags and wearing rainbow colors. Demonstrators also planned to plant Pride flags on the school's front lawn. Protesters criticised the decision as insensitive and motivated by hostility, while school board President David Bell defended the policy, stating the district must represent all students equally.
demands: Keep the Progress Pride flag flying daily at Sonoma Valley High School
Reject the new restrictive school district flag policy
response: School board President David Bell defended the policy during the Oct. 8 meeting, stating that the district's responsibility as trustees is to represent all students equally.

crowd.text: Hundreds of students and neighbors rallied in front of Sonoma Valley High School Tuesday.

updates.text: The Sonoma Valley Unified School District Board of Trustees voted 3-2 to approve a new flag policy restricting flag displays.
Hundreds of students and community members rallied and staged a walkout outside Sonoma Valley High School wearing rainbow colors.
Demonstrators planned to plant Pride flags on the high school's front lawn in an act of defiance.

sources.title: Students plan mass walkout as major California school district strips Pride flags from all buildings
